description: Button with built-in confirmation dialog. First click shows 'Are you sure? Yes/No' inline confirmation; 'Yes' emits the action, 'No' or a 6-second timeout resets to the original button. Used for destructive or important actions that need user confirmation.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Element ID, also used for data-testing-id attribute binding

inputs.name: buttonText
inputs.description: Button display text shown in initial (non-confirmation) state

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the button and prevents showing confirmation

inputs.name: disableButton
inputs.description: Alternative disable flag (deprecated — use disabled instead)

inputs.name: disableTooltipContent
inputs.description: Tooltip text shown when button is disabled

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class for left icon

inputs.name: iconCap
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class for right icon

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Controls button and confirmation dialog size

inputs.name: uiIconName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the left icon (signal input)

inputs.name: uiIconCapName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the right cap icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconColor
inputs.description: Color for the SVG icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconSize
inputs.description: Size for the SVG icon (signal input)

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: Emitted when user confirms the action by clicking 'Yes'

expected_internal_elements.description: Container div that houses both the button and confirmation states
The initial button shown before confirmation (hidden during confirmation)
Confirmation dialog with 'Are you sure?' text and Yes/No link buttons (visible only during confirmation state)
Yes and No link buttons inside the confirmation dialog

behaviors.description: Component renders and is visible in the DOM
In initial state, the general button is visible and the confirmation dialog is hidden
In initial state, the confirmation dialog is not rendered
Clicking the button shows the 'Are you sure?' confirmation dialog
The confirmation dialog contains 'Are you sure?' text and Yes/No buttons
Clicking 'Yes' emits the action event and resets to initial state
Clicking 'No' resets to initial button state without emitting action
After 6 seconds without interaction, the confirmation dialog resets to initial button state
When disabled, clicking the button does not show the confirmation dialog
The container div gets the size CSS class
When fullWidth is true, the host element gets the 'full-width' class
